name: attacker-verifier
description: Counterexample-grounded security checking for agent-generated code: an attacker proposes proof-of-concept probes, a faithfulness check filters them, and a verifier judges their sandboxed execution traces.

attacker.title: Attacker
attacker.description: Who generates the adversarial probes. 'main coding agent' runs it inline; choosing a model runs the dedicated attacker agent (up to 20 turns) on that model.

verifier.title: Verifier (trace judge)
verifier.description: Who judges execution traces the crash oracle leaves undecided. 'main coding agent' runs it inline; choosing a model runs the dedicated verifier agent on that model.

probes_min.title: Probes per target (min)
probes_min.description: Minimum number of proof-of-concept probes the attacker generates per target.

probes_max.title: Probes per target (max)
probes_max.description: Maximum number of proof-of-concept probes the attacker generates per target.

num_turns.title: Repair turns (secure-code-generation)
num_turns.description: How many attack -> verify -> repair cycles /secure-code-generation runs before returning the best version.

max_targets.title: Max targets per run
max_targets.description: Cap on how many functions, methods, or classes a single run attacks.
